record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.original_question: Do there exist universal infinitesimal symmetries Q(P) of Poisson structures that are nonlinear, proper, valid for all finite-dimensional affine Poisson manifolds, and not produced from graph cocycles through Kontsevich’s orientation morphism O→r?

evidence.quote: Problem 7. Are there any other nonlinear proper infinitesimal symmetries Q(P) ∈ sym([[P,P]] = 0) which are universal with respect to all (affine) Poisson manifolds of arbitrary finite dimension but which are not obtained from the graph cocycles by using Kontsevich’s orientation morphism O→r ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $M$ be a finite-dimensional affine Poisson manifold, i.e. an affine space equipped with a Poisson bivector $P \in \Gamma(\Lambda^2 TM)$ satisfying the Jacobi identity $[\![P,P]\!] = 0$, where $[\![\cdot,\cdot]\!]$ denotes the Schouten–Nijenhuis bracket. An infinitesimal symmetry of the Poisson structure is a bivector-valued functional $Q(P) \in \Gamma(\Lambda^2 TM)$, polynomial-differential in the components of $P$, such that the linearized Jacobi identity holds:
$$[\![P, Q(P)]\!] = 0.$$
Such a symmetry $Q$ is called:
- universal if a single universal differential-polynomial expression in $P$ defines $Q(P)$ simultaneously for every affine Poisson manifold of every finite dimension;
- proper if it is not of the form $[\![P, X(P)]\!]$ for any vector field $X(P)$ that is itself a universal differential-polynomial in $P$ (i.e. it is nontrivial in the relevant Poisson cohomology);
- nonlinear if its expression involves at least two copies of $P$ (so that it is not linear in $P$).

Kontsevich's orientation morphism $\mathrm{O}\vec{r}$ is a linear map from the (unoriented) graph complex to the space of universal differential-polynomial bivectors on affine Poisson manifolds: to each cocycle $\gamma$ in the Kontsevich graph complex it associates a universal infinitesimal symmetry $\mathrm{O}\vec{r}(\gamma)(P)$ of $P$, obtained by summing over all admissible orientations of $\gamma$ with two outgoing edges at a chosen vertex and decorating each oriented edge with a copy of $P$.

Question. Do there exist nonlinear, proper, universal infinitesimal symmetries $Q(P)$ of Poisson structures (universal with respect to all finite-dimensional affine Poisson manifolds) that do not arise as $\mathrm{O}\vec{r}(\gamma)$ for any cocycle $\gamma$ in the Kontsevich graph complex (modulo trivial symmetries)?
artifact.category_tag: Kontsevich graph complex and Poisson symmetries
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on the Kontsevich graph orientation morphism (e.g., the orientation morphism studies and pentagon/heptagon-wheel cocycle constructions from 2017–2020) describes how graph cocycles produce universal infinitesimal symmetries of Poisson structures, but does not exhibit any nonlinear, proper, universal symmetry outside the image of Or. No source found claims to have produced or ruled out such non-graph universal symmetries, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Kontsevich graph orientation morphism revisited
status_evidence.snippet: The orientation morphism associates differential-polynomial flows on spaces of bi-vectors with finite unoriented graphs... cocycles are mapped to infinitesimal symmetries of Poisson bi-vectors.
status_evidence.claim: Describes the orientation morphism producing universal Poisson symmetries from graph cocycles, with no claim of non-graph universal examples.

status_evidence.title: Universal Cocycles and the Graph Complex Action on Homogeneous Poisson Brackets
status_evidence.snippet: Universal — with respect to all affine Poisson manifolds — infinitesimal symmetries of classical Poisson structures are obtained from the Kontsevich graph complex.
status_evidence.claim: Known universal symmetries arise via the graph complex; no construction outside this image is reported.

status_evidence.title: Poisson brackets symmetry from the pentagon-wheel cocycle in the graph complex
status_evidence.snippet: Pentagon-wheel cocycle yields a universal flow on the space of Poisson structures.
status_evidence.claim: Examples of universal symmetries continue to be produced via Or; no non-graph examples announced.
